column2: do,complete,or use a more specific command verb
bad (adjective). note: give accurate and correct conditions if possible
effect (noun). note: be specific if possible
in progress,no other,before now,before this. note: you can frequently omit this word and not change the meaning of your sentence
in one ... and then in the other
if ... not. note: failure is a technical name when it means a performance error or loss of serviceability
small number. note: if possible. give a specific number
damage,defective (adjective). note: be as specific as possible
immediately,only (adjective). note: you can frequently omit this word and not change the meaning of your sentence
continue,continue (verb) note: also refer to in progress (adverb)
note: in general,use the word again (adverb) or back (adverb) with the basic word to replace words that have "re-" as a prefix
some,many (adjective). note: if these alternatives are not sufficient,give the range,quantity
time (noun). note: give the time if possible
